title: 2 Samuel Goliath named-reference profile restoration
decisionJa: 2SA21:19 explicitly names “Goliath the Gittite” as the brother of the person killed by Elhanan. The named person is a direct kinship referent even though he is not the person killed. A 2SA-scoped profile is restored with same identity to 1SA17 left unresolved; do not conflate the brother with Goliath or claim the 1SA warrior’s death here. Wikipedia is a related-section link only, relationVerified true / identityVerified false.
profileSummaryJa: 2サムエル記21:19は、エルハナンが「ギト人ゴリアトの兄弟」を殺したと記します。ここでゴリアトは兄弟関係を示す名として現れますが、ゴリアト本人が殺されたとは書かれていません。サムエル記上17章に登場するゴリアトと同一人物かは、この節だけでは確定できません。

afterArticleReadCorrection.locator: Article lines 243–247 (and opening lines 186–190). The article presents the 2 Samuel 21:19 Goliath wording and notes that the Hebrew text lacks “brother”; the fixed WEB wording differs. Link remains related-only and does not decide which textual reading applies.
